note: Authoritative frozen contract for the native phase-suite validator, contract_revision 6 (supersedes revision 5 of the admission pin-file repair and revision 4 of the epoch-aware repair; the admission no longer carries per-phase pins). Revision 5 is the admission pin-file repair; revision 6 pins the DERIVATION FIELDSET to the wire RuntimeProfile fieldset (occ3_sglang.latent_types.RuntimeProfile): the per-boot digest covers the static profile fields, the frozen-artifact reference calibration_path/calibration_digest - carried empty by the per-message method, never absent - and the observed runtime_epoch/runtime_generation, for every registered method alike. profile_digest is incarnation-bound (fresh per boot) and the live server epoch exists only after the candidate boots, so the frozen pre-boot admission is STATIC-ONLY and each phase's OBSERVED digest arrives as a write-once attempt-dir pin file (admission-pin-<phase>.json, schema occ3.admission.pin.v1, bound to the attempt, the pinned static input file digest 6e676f1c6fc795ba412c4327168b51c8ef6f65056664638c4954eec58e75348a and the phase's observed runtime_epoch/runtime_generation); each phase's report binding must equal its phase pin AND re-derive from the static fields plus the phase's observed incarnation (sha256 over sorted-key compact ASCII canonical JSON, attachment_contract.digest parity), and equal before/after pins are refused as fabricated pre-restart. All values are synthetic; no real endpoint, credential, identity, nonce, handle or artifact is present. The Rust harness must produce reports satisfying these exact fieldsets and invariants; the Python adapter is the verifier, never a proof.
invariants: adapter writes one fresh exclusive per-phase challenge before any waiting; one challenge, one attempt, no replay
report echoes attempt_id, candidate_id, candidate_started_at and validator_challenge exactly
report harness binding equals admission-pinned binary sha256, platform and canonical source-manifest digest

report identity/method/origin bindings equal admission pins; method is statebridge.glm53.final-prenorm-predictor.continuous-prefix.v1 only; profile_digest is incarnation-bound (per-boot) and never statically pinned: each phase's binding must equal its phase's attempt-dir admission pin file (admission-pin-<phase>.json, schema occ3.admission.pin.v1, write-once after the identity derivation receipt; static_input_sha256 pinned to native-profile-input.json 6e676f1c6fc795ba412c4327168b51c8ef6f65056664638c4954eec58e75348a) and must re-derive from the admission's static profile fields, the frozen-artifact reference (calibration_path/calibration_digest, empty for the per-message method) and that phase's observed runtime_epoch/runtime_generation - the full RuntimeProfile fieldset, identical for every registered method (sha256 over sorted-key compact ASCII canonical JSON; report_profile_derivation_mismatch otherwise); equal before/after pin digests are refused as fabricated pre-restart (profile_digest_pins_not_per_boot)
observed runtime/layout fields come from actual native enrollment on the started candidate; ready_ranks equals expected_ranks equals challenge expected_ranks
positive case: normalized answer hashes to the suite nonce, one delivered message, lease Consumed before tool execution, receiver audit source_facts_absent with max_tokens 131072 and request_count 1

report publication: the harness must create a uniquely named private staging file in the same filesystem/attempt directory, write exclusively and bounded, flush and fsync, verify the exact complete bytes, then publish atomically at the exact final expected name WITHOUT replacing any existing target; the final report is immutable afterwards; no final name may exist while content is incomplete; failed or partial staging remains private and ineligible; an existing final target means refuse/no-replay, never overwrite (ordinary temp+os.replace alone is NOT proof of no-replace; platform-specific no-replace atomic publication plus ACL proof is future native-harness work)
no-state case: same suite nonce binding, exact normalized UNKNOWN answer, semantic_nonce_match false, zero messages/consumed/tool calls; an arbitrary non-match is not a pass

before phase keeps exactly one known captured unpublished/unretired negative control recorded as negative_control_retained with retention_reason planned_restart; logical cleanup covers positive/no-state cases only; no overall GPU-free or all-leases-retired claim

after phase stale probe: fresh original-session enrollment under the new actual epoch, one attempt, exact 409 error code state; 200, expired, replay, any 401/4xx-auth, 5xx, timeout or malformed never counts
after phase binds stale artifact digest to the before retained artifact digest and proves a new runtime epoch and generation
no raw nonce, answer, source handle, credential value or credential-value hash appears anywhere in a report; digests and header names only
gpu_free_proven is always false; physical GPU free is never claimed from registry release or cleanup

json encoding and depth bound: all control/admission/report documents are strict UTF-8 only (no autodetect/BOM/replacement; invalid encoding refused as malformed_json) and bounded to nesting depth 32 (MAX_JSON_DEPTH); deeper documents are refused as malformed_json; this is not a model-payload bound and no heap/RSS bound is claimed

controlled restart profile: this validation profile requires the same candidate container stop/start with the retained native-incarnation counter; the current generation must ADVANCE (strictly greater than the previous), not merely differ; a volatile-reset runtime (lost /tmp record restarting generation at 1) is NOT admitted by this profile; no epoch-only fallback; missing/reset counter fails the attempted validation into ordinary recovery

publication.staging: uniquely named private file in the same filesystem/attempt directory; exclusive bounded write; flush+fsync; verify exact complete bytes before publish
publication.atomicity: publish at the exact final expected name without replacing any existing target; report immutable afterwards; existing final target means refuse/no-replay
publication.adapter_waiting: missing final name waits bounded by the plan validation deadline; a malformed final name is an immediate protocol-violation refusal, never retried or ignored
publication.proof_boundary: this synthetic fixture does not prove real Windows no-replace atomic publication or ACL behavior; that remains future native-harness work

json_depth.scope: control/admission/report documents only; not model payloads
json_depth.encoding: strict UTF-8 only: byte bound first, then strict UTF-8 decode (no autodetection, no BOM stripping, no replacement) BEFORE the depth scan and parse; parsing runs on the decoded text so json.loads encoding autodetection cannot re-enter; UTF-16, UTF-32, invalid UTF-8 and any BOM are refused as a fixed value-free malformed_json

restart_profile.required: same candidate container stop/start with retained native-incarnation counter
restart_profile.reset_handling: missing/reset counter fails the attempted validation; ordinary recovery runs; no automatic reset/repair/retry
restart_profile.epoch_rule: fresh candidate StartedAt and fresh runtime epoch still required
